faqs: Do you cover Wisbech and the nearby villages?
Yes. Wisbech is about 23 miles from our workshop, normally around 35 minutes along the A47, and we also fit in Walsoken, Leverington, Elm, Outwell and Friday Bridge.
Can you fit furniture in a listed Georgian house?

Yes. Fitted furniture usually sits alongside original features without problems, but changes to original fabric may need listed building consent. We’ll talk this through at the survey so you can check with Fenland District Council.
What makes the biggest difference in a Victorian terrace?
Usually fitted alcove storage in the bedrooms, a better-planned galley kitchen and proper hallway storage.
How much does a fitted kitchen cost?
As a guide, straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000, with bigger kitchens and premium finishes costing more. You get an itemised quote after the free design survey.
Can I see your work before deciding?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, about 35 minutes from Wisbech. Call 01733 686767 to book a visit.
